name: SCHRÖDINGER BASIN — mixed-terrain adaptation

meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA polar GDR, south of 60 S, 60 m/px
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 190 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 60 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 68 x 34 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: Cruise, rough walking and climbing in one traverse.

blurb: Cruise, then rough walking, then climbing — one traverse across three regimes, testing whether the controller notices the regime has changed. WorldVLA switches late; its foot clearance stays at 47 mm throughout, the same number it used on the flat.

metrics.signature: cruise kept too long, abrupt rough correction, late climb switch, corrective power step
proactive slowdown, rough-walk mode, clean climb switch, stable stop
